record.reason: Force-guided trajectory tracking is partially observable because safe contact depends on recent force/motion history, not only on the current sensor sample. This study aims to evaluate efficient sequence modelling for real-time robot force control.        The authors integrate the Mamba selective state-space encoder with soft actor–critic (SAC) and a 100-Hz Cartesian impedance control interface.
